_doc: UST corpus gate manifest (.scratch/ust-corpus-gate). Selection: the 20 most recent @pifuyuu uploads, skip-and-backfill with reasons in 'excluded'. UST files are never committed (the author's terms forbid redistribution); fetch them with scripts/fetch-pifuyuu-ust.sh. stratum 'vocaloid-original' = any synthesized vocal (VOCALOID/CeVIO/Synthesizer V/UTAU), the gate; 'human-sung' is watched, never tuned against. ust_lead_files = main* plus a sung intro, merged into one reference; ust_other_voice_files = every other voice in the original (harmony, doubling, delay/echo, backing vocalise, spoken), used to find monophonic regions. Timing: stem_time = ust_time + alignment_offset_s. split: 'dev' songs are for iterating/tuning, 'holdout' songs are scored once at the end; assigned by upload order before any tuning (1st, 3rd, 5th… most recent = dev). Split 'holdout2' (added 2026-11-21): a fresh holdout of the next 10 uploads in channel order after the first 21 (2026-10-01 → 10-22), same skip-and-backfill rules; read once to confirm ADR-0016, logged in holdout-reads.jsonl. Split 'holdout3' (added 2026-11-21): a fresh holdout of the next uploads in channel order before holdout2's oldest (2026-08-14 → 09-29), same skip-and-backfill rules (vocaloid-original only; original resolvable and within 1 s of the cover; one integer tempo across lead and other-voice files, grid 16 or 24), plus one: an upload whose UST is not in ust_share_url (Pifuyuu posted it only on BowlRoll) is skipped, because the fetch script reads only that share. 10 songs, all aligned (05), no backfill needed; unread when added.
ust_terms: https://pifuyuuust.blogspot.com/ — credit the original author, the MIDI author and Pifuyuu; no redistribution (converted formats included)
